description: Create or change the shop of a site in one transaction: settings, products, variants, stock, prices, shipping rates and discount codes. Use it whenever the user asks for a webshop, wants to start selling or asks to add, change or remove products; the shop is created on first use, so never send the user to the dashboard to type products. Ask only for facts you cannot know (price, stock, delivery cost). For an existing shop call get_shop first: products and discount codes are merged by key and code, but shippingRates replaces the whole list. Requires the owner or admin role. The result lists nextSteps; normally the single manual step is connecting Mollie in the dashboard.

discounts.description: Create or update discount codes. Omitted codes are retained.

active.description: Allow buyers to redeem this code.

code.description: Unique discount code, 2 to 32 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.

endsAt.description: Expiry date or ISO timestamp, or null.

maxRedemptions.description: Maximum redemptions, or null for unlimited.

startsAt.description: First valid date or ISO timestamp, or null.

type.description: percent or fixed, required for a new code.

value.description: Whole percent (1 to 100) or fixed cents, required for a new code.

products.description: Create or update products by key. Omitted products are retained.

active.description: Show the product in the public catalogue.

group.description: Shared group for variants of the same product.

imageUrl.description: Product image as an HTTPS URL or a site-relative path.

interval.description: Subscription billing interval, for example 1 month or 2 weeks, at most one year.

key.description: Unique product handle, 1 to 63 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.

maxPerOrder.description: Per-order quantity cap, 1 to 999, or null.

metadata.description: JSON object of storefront attributes, up to 2000 bytes.

name.description: Product name, required for a new product.

priceCents.description: Gross unit price in cents, required for a new product. Subscriptions cost at least 100 cents.

requiresShipping.description: Whether checkout needs a delivery address.

stock.description: Available units from 0 to 1000000, or null for unlimited.

variantLabel.description: Label for this variant in a picker.

vatRate.description: VAT percentage, 0 to 100 with up to two decimal places.

removeProducts.description: Product keys to delete. Existing order snapshots are retained.

settings.description: Shop settings to change. Omitted fields keep their values.

currency.description: EUR, USD, GBP, CHF, SEK, DKK, NOK or PLN. Locked after the first order.

locale.description: Shop language: nl, en, fr or de.

notificationEmails.description: Up to five recipients of merchant notices.

termsUrl.description: HTTPS address of the shop terms, or null to clear.

shippingRates.description: Replace all rates. Keep existing ids to update them. An empty list clears shipping rates.

active.description: Offer this shipping option at checkout.

countries.description: Two-letter country codes or a single wildcard (*).

freeFromCents.description: Free shipping threshold after discounts, or null.

id.description: Existing rate id from get_shop. Omit to create a rate.

siteName.description: Site name as returned by list_sites.

name: set_shop
title: Configure a site's shop catalogue
